title: Khara's war with Rama
introduction: Khara the demon brother of Shuurpanakha confronts Rama when all of his valiant warriors are eliminated. He wages a fearful war showing all his expertise and he even brings down the amour of Rama with his arrows. The combat of Rama and Khara takes a longer time, as Khara is not easy-to-deal demon.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे अष्ट विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 28th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
निहतम् दूषणम् दृष्ट्वा रणे त्रिशिरसा सह |
खरस्य अपि अभवत् त्रासो दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम्
verses.iast:
nihatam dūṣaṇam dṛṣṭvā raṇe triśirasā saha |
kharasya api abhavat trāso dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam
verses.translation: Khara is intimidated on seeing the elimination of Duushana along with Trishira inasmuch as the intrepidity of Rama is concerned.

verses.devanagari:
स दृष्ट्वा राक्षसम् सैन्यम् अविषह्यम् महाबलम् |
हतम् एकेन रामेण दूषणः त्रिशिरा अपि
तद् बलम् हत भूयिष्ठम् विमनाः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसः |
आससाद खरो रामम् नमुचिर् वासवम् यथा
verses.iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā rākṣasam sainyam aviṣahyam mahābalam |
hatam ekena rāmeṇa dūṣaṇaḥ triśirā api
tad balam hata bhūyiṣṭham vimanāḥ prekṣya rākṣasaḥ |
āsasāda kharo rāmam namucir vāsavam yathā
verses.translation: On seeing the annihilation of the insufferable and mighty force of demons, even that of Duushana and Trishira by lone Rama, and thus to apprehend that the demonic force is wholly destructed, that demon Khara became apprehensive, and then he lunged at Rama, as with demon Namuchi who once lunged at Indra.

glosses.meaning: by lone one, by Rama, as annihilated
Namuchi [the demon,] to Indra, as with
at Rama, reached out - lunged at.

verses.devanagari:
विकृष्य बलवत् चापम् नाराचान् रक्त भोजनान् |
खरः चिक्षेप रामाय क्रुद्धान् आशी विषान् इव
verses.iast:
vikṛṣya balavat cāpam nārācān rak{}ta bhojanān |
kharaḥ cikṣepa rāmāya kruddhān āśī viṣān iva
verses.translation: Forcefully drawing the bowstring fitted with iron-arrows, which looked like furious serpents of venom ingesting only blood, Khara discharged them on Rama.

glosses.meaning: furious one [arrows,] snake, venomous ones, like [arrows]
that have blood, as their meals

verses.devanagari:
ज्याम् विधुन्वन् सुबहुशः शिक्षया अस्त्राणि दर्शयन् |
चचार समरे मार्गान् शरै रथ गतः खरः
verses.iast:
jyām vidhunvan subahuśaḥ śikṣayā astrāṇi darśayan |
cacāra samare mārgān śarai ratha gataḥ kharaḥ
verses.translation: Fidgeting with bowstring in many a way, brandishing missiles with many a skill, Khara moved about the battleground in many a manner, seated on chariot and showing his expertise with arrows.

glosses.meaning: in many ways - in many a manner, moved about.

verses.devanagari:
स सर्वाः च दिशो बाणैः प्रदिशः च महारथः |
पूरयामास तम् दृष्ट्वा रामो अपि सुमहत् धनुः
स सायकैः दुर्विषहैः स स्फुलिन्गैः इव अग्निभिः |
नभः चकार अविवरम् पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिभिः
verses.iast:
sa sarvāḥ ca diśo bāṇaiḥ pradiśaḥ ca mahārathaḥ |
pūrayāmāsa tam dṛṣṭvā rāmo api sumahat dhanuḥ
sa sāyakaiḥ dur.hviṣahaiḥ sa sphulingaiḥ iva agnibhiḥ |
nabhaḥ cakāra avivaram parjanya iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: That great chariot-fighter Khara then started to fill all the stretches and inter-stretches with arrows, seeing that even Rama reciprocally started to take aim with his bow Rama, and then filled and made the sky less of leeway with verily unendurable arrows that are like tongues of fire emitting sparks, as with Rain-god chocking the sky with torrents, less of latitude.

glosses.itrans: sarvaaH dishaH ca pra dishaH ca
glosses.iast: sarvāḥ diśaḥ ca pra diśaḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: सर्वाः दिशः च प्र दिशः च

glosses.meaning: [his] very, great, bow, started to pull the bowstring - take aim [in reciprocation]

verses.devanagari:
तद् बभूव शितैः बाणैः खर राम विसर्जितैः |
परि आकाशम् अनाकाशम् सर्वतः शर संकुलम्
verses.iast:
tad babhūva śitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara rāma visar.hjitaiḥ |
pari ākāśam anākāśam sarvataḥ śara saṃkulam
verses.translation: No empty space is left out in the space around since it has become riotous with the sharp arrows discharged by Rama and Khara from everywhere.

glosses.meaning: that, vault of, sky - in and around there

verses.devanagari:
शर जाल आवृतः सूर्यो न तदा स्म प्रकाशते |
अन्योन्य वध संरम्भात् उभयोः संप्रयुध्यतोः
verses.iast:
śara jāla āvṛtaḥ sūryo na tadā sma prakāśate |
anyonya vadha saṃrambhāt ubhayoḥ samprayudhyatoḥ
verses.translation: While both of them are warring with excitement to slay one another, then the sun obscured with the mesh of arrows has not shined.

glosses.meaning: one, another, to slay, in excitement

verses.devanagari:
ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः च विकर्णिभिः |
आजघान रणे रामम् तोत्रैर् इव महा द्विपम्
verses.iast:
tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ ca vikar.hṇibhiḥ |
ājaghāna raṇe rāmam totrair iva mahā dvipam
verses.translation: Then with acutely edged tubular, iron, and crescent-edged arrows Khara swatted Rama in that combat, as a great elephant will be swatted with a goad.

glosses.meaning: with a goad, great, elephant, as with

verses.devanagari:
तम् रथस्थम् धनुष् पाणिम् राक्षसम् पर्यवस्थितम् |
ददृशुः सर्व भूतानि पाश हस्तम् इव अंतकम्
verses.iast:
tam rathastham dhanuṣ pāṇim rākṣasam paryavasthitam |
dadṛśuḥ sarva bhūtāni pāśa hastam iva aṃtakam
verses.translation: When charioted Khara came to the presence of Rama with bow in hand and ready for a close combat, that demon appeared to all beings as the Terminator handling his noose.

glosses.meaning: who is in the presence, ready for a close combat
all, beings, saw at - appeared to be.

verses.devanagari:
हन्तारम् सर्व सैन्यस्य पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितम् |
परिश्रन्तम् महासत्त्वम् मेने रामम् खरः तदा
verses.iast:
hantāram sarva sainyasya pauruṣe paryavasthitam |
pariśrantam mahāsattvam mene rāmam kharaḥ tadā
verses.translation: Khara presumed that greatly indefatigable Rama is wholly fatigued by now, though he has shown his mettle of boldness in eliminating all of the demonic forces, all the while.

glosses.meaning: in boldness, abiding - shown his mettle with boldness

verses.devanagari:
तम् सिंहम् इव विक्रान्तम् सिंह विक्रान्त गामिनम् |
दृष्ट्वा न उद्विजते रामः सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा
verses.iast:
tam siṃham iva vikrāntam siṃha vikrānta gāminam |
dṛṣṭvā na udvijate rāmaḥ siṃhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā
verses.translation: On seeing Khara who is prancing like a lion with a gait of a lion, Rama is unruffled like a lion that sees a least beast.
notes: For the last compound in second foot the other versions contain siṃhaḥ siṃham iva aparam 'a lion on seeing another lion...' Firstly comparing Khara with lion and later comparing him with kśudra mṛga 'petty animal...' is not found aesthetic by some scholars.

glosses.meaning: one who is - lion, pace, with the gait
lion, at least, beat, as with

verses.devanagari:
ततः सूर्य निकाशेन रथेन महता खरः |
आससाद अथ तम् रामम् पतंग इव पावकम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sūrya nikāśena rathena mahatā kharaḥ |
āsasāda atha tam rāmam pataṃga iva pāvakam
verses.translation: In a chariot that equals the sun in its radiance then Khara reached Rama as a moth reaches fire.

glosses.meaning: by great - radiant one, by chariot
a moth, towards fire, as with

verses.devanagari:
ततो अस्य सशरम् चापम् मुष्टि देशे महात्मनः |
खरः चिच्छ्हेद रामस्य दर्शयन् हस्त लाघवम्
verses.iast:
tato asya saśaram cāpam muṣṭi deśe mahātmanaḥ |
kharaḥ cicchheda rāmasya darśayan hasta lāghavam
verses.translation: Showing sleight of hand Khara then broke the handgrip of the bow of that great-souled Rama along with an arrow fitted on it.

glosses.meaning: at the fist, place- at handgrip

verses.devanagari:
स पुनः तु अपरान् सप्त शरान् आदाय वर्मणि |
निजघान रणे क्रुद्धः शक्र अशनि सम प्रभान्
verses.iast:
sa punaḥ tu aparān sapta śarān ādāya varmaṇi |
nijaghāna raṇe kruddhaḥ śakra aśani sama prabhān
verses.translation: Still infuriated Khara has drawn seven more arrows that equal the radiance of Indra's thunderbolts and hit Rama's armour in that war.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शर सहस्रेण रामम् अप्रतिम ओजसम् |
अर्दयित्वा महानादम् ननाद समेरे खरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ śara sahasreṇa rāmam apratima ojasam |
ar.hdayitvā mahānādam nanāda samere kharaḥ
verses.translation: Then, on distressing Rama of unequalled vitality with a thousand arrows in that combat Khara blared a loud blare.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तत् प्रहतम् बाणैः खर मुक्तैः सुपर्वभिः |
पपात कवचम् भूमौ रामस्य आदित्य वर्चसः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tat prahatam bāṇaiḥ khara muk{}taiḥ supar.hvabhiḥ |
papāta kavacam bhūmau rāmasya āditya varcasaḥ
verses.translation: With the arrows released by Khara that have a great egress, then that armour of Rama that has a sun-like resplendence is completely destroyed and fell on the field.

verses.devanagari:
स शरैः अर्पितः क्रुद्धः सर्व गात्रेषु राघवः |
रराज समरे रामो विधूमो अग्निर् इव ज्वलन्
verses.iast:
sa śaraiḥ arpitaḥ kruddhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ |
rarāja samare rāmo vidhūmo agnir iva jvalan
verses.translation: When all his limbs are hit with arrows Rama is enraged and in that war Rama flared up like a fumeless flaring fire.

glosses.meaning: with arrows, in all, limbs, given to - hit
one from Raghu's dynasty, he that, Rama

verses.devanagari:
ततो गंभीर निर्ह्रादम् रामः शत्रु निबर्हणः |
चकार अंताय स रिपोः सज्यम् अन्यन् महत् धनुः
verses.iast:
tato gambhīra nirhrādam rāmaḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ |
cakāra aṃtāya sa ripoḥ sajyam anyan mahat dhanuḥ
verses.translation: Then Rama, the blaster of enemies, strung bowstring to another thunderously blasting bow, to end the enemy.

verses.devanagari:
सुमहत् वैष्णवम् यत् तत् अतिसृष्टम् महर्षिणा |
वरम् तत् धनुः उद्यम्य खरम् समभिधावत
verses.iast:
sumahat vaiṣṇavam yat tat atisṛṣṭam maharṣiṇā |
varam tat dhanuḥ udyamya kharam samabhidhāvata
verses.translation: That which is a very admirable bow of Vishnu and that which is awarded by great-sage Agastya, upraising that choicest bow Rama rushed towards Khara.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कनक पुंखैः तु शरैः संनत पर्वभिः |
चिच्छ्हेद रामः संक्रुद्धः खरस्य समरे ध्वजम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kanaka puṃkhaiḥ tu śaraiḥ saṃnata par.hvabhiḥ |
cicchheda rāmaḥ saṅkruddhaḥ kharasya samare dhvajam
verses.translation: With arrows that have golden fins and curved barbs that highly infuriated Rama then fragmented Khara's flagstaff with flag in that war.

verses.devanagari:
स दर्शनीयो बहुधा विच्छ्हिन्नः कांचनो ध्वजः |
जगाम धरणीम् सूर्यो देवतानाम् इव आज्ञया
verses.iast:
sa darśanīyo bahudhā vicchhinnaḥ kāṃcano dhvajaḥ |
jagāma dharaṇīm sūryo devatānām iva ājñayā
verses.translation: That eye-pleasing golden flagstaff with flag is severally shattered and fell onto ground as if it is god-damned sun fallen on earth.

glosses.meaning: to earth, went - fallen on earth.

verses.devanagari:
तम् चतुर्भिः खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् गात्रेषु मार्गणैः |
विव्याध हृदि मर्मज्ञो मातंगम् इव तोमरैः
verses.iast:
tam caturbhiḥ kharaḥ kruddho rāmam gātreṣu mārgaṇaiḥ |
vivyādha hṛdi marmajño mātaṃgam iva tomaraiḥ
verses.translation: By that Khara is enraged, and as one who is aware of striking crucial parts/war tactics assaulted on the chest of Rama with four arrows, and even on other limbs, as one would prod an elephant with lancets.

glosses.meaning: crucial points, knower [or, knower of war tactics]
elephant, with lancets as if [one would prod]

verses.devanagari:
स रामो बहुभिः बाणैः खर कार्मुक निःसृतैः |
विद्धो रुधिर सिक्तांगो बभूव रुषितो भृशम्
verses.iast:
sa rāmo bahubhiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara kārmuka niḥsṛtaiḥ |
viddho rudhira sik{}tāṃgo babhūva ruṣito bhṛśam
verses.translation: Impacted with various arrows unloosened from the bow of Khara, limbs of Rama are drenched in blood and he became highly indignant.

verses.devanagari:
स धनुर् धन्विनाम् श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य परम आहवे |
मुमोच परम इष्वासः षट् शरान् अभिलक्षितान्
verses.iast:
sa dhanur dhanvinām śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya parama āhave |
mumoca parama iṣvāsaḥ ṣaṭ śarān abhilakṣitān
verses.translation: On aiming his great bow that ablest one among archers, namely Rama, then in that war released six arrows targeting pointedly.

glosses.meaning: the arrow that have already targeted their targets - targeting pointedly

verses.devanagari:
शिरसि एकेन बाणेन द्वाभ्याम् बाह्वोर् अथ आर्पयत् |
त्रिभिः चन्द्र अर्ध वक्त्रैः च वक्षसि अभिजघान ह
verses.iast:
śirasi ekena bāṇena dvābhyām bāhvor atha ārpayat |
tribhiḥ candra ardha vak{}traiḥ ca vakṣasi abhijaghāna ha
verses.translation: Rama indeed hit Khara's head with one arrow, with two his hands, and next with three crescent shaped arrows he hit his chest.

glosses.meaning: only one, with arrow, on head
with three, moon, half, faced ones, also [crescent shaped arrows]

verses.devanagari:
ततः पश्चात् महातेजा नाराचान् भास्कर उपमान् |
जघान राक्षसम् क्रुद्धः त्रयोदश शिला अशितान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ paścāt mahātejā nārācān bhāskara upamān |
jaghāna rākṣasam kruddhaḥ trayodaśa śilā aśitān
verses.translation: Then afterwards that great-resplendent Rama wishing to eliminate the demon, infuriately launched thirteen iron arrows that are sharply whetted and similar to the dazzle of sun.

verses.devanagari:
रथस्य युगम् एकेन चतुर्भिः शबलान् हयान् |
षष्ठेन च शिरः संख्ये चिच्छ्हेद खर सारथेः
त्रिभिः त्रिवेणून् बलवान् द्वाभ्याम् अक्षम् महाबलः |
द्वादशेन तु बाणेन खरस्य स शरम् धनुः
छ्हित्त्वा वज्र निकाशेन राघवः प्रहसन् इव |
त्रयोदशेन इन्द्र समो बिभेद समरे खरम्
verses.iast:
rathasya yugam ekena caturbhiḥ śabalān hayān |
ṣaṣṭhena ca śiraḥ saṅkhye cicchheda khara sāratheḥ
tribhiḥ triveṇūn balavān dvābhyām akṣam mahābalaḥ |
dvādaśena tu bāṇena kharasya sa śaram dhanuḥ
chhittvā vajra nikāśena rāghavaḥ prahasan iva |
trayodaśena indra samo bibheda samare kharam
verses.translation: That mighty Raghava who equals Indra in combats, smiling at the warfare of Khara, smashed the yoke of the chariot with one arrow; with four, four of the dappled horses; with the sixth, the head of the charioteer of Khara; with three, the three-pronged shaft from yoke to the base of chariot; with two the axels, thus that chariot is fragmented. Then, on wrecking Khara's bow on which an arrow is placed with the twelfth, that mighty one Rama impaled Khara with the thirteenth arrow that is similar to a thunderbolt.

glosses.meaning: Indra, one who is equal to [Rama]
laughing at [making a sport of,] as though
with three [arrows,] three-pronged shaft [from yoke to body of chariot]

verses.devanagari:
प्रभग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः |
गदा पाणिः अवप्लुत्य तस्थौ भूमौ खरः तदा
verses.iast:
prabhagna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ |
gadā pāṇiḥ avaplutya tasthau bhūmau kharaḥ tadā
verses.translation: With his bow utterly shattered, chariot fragmented, horses killed, and charioteer felled, that Khara then hopped down to ground from the dilapidated chariot wielding a mace, and stood fast.

verses.devanagari:
तत् कर्म रामस्य महारथस्य
समेत्य देवाः च महर्षयः च |
अपूजयन् प्रांजलयः प्रहृष्टाः
तदा विमान अग्र गताः समेताः
verses.iast:
tat karma rāmasya mahārathasya
sametya devāḥ ca maharṣayaḥ ca |
apūjayan prāṃjalayaḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ
tadā vimāna agra gatāḥ sametāḥ
verses.translation: The gods as well as great-sages have then came together and assembled in heavens, and those assemblies that are aboard their aircrafts are highly gladdened at the exploit of the great chariot-fighter Rama, and they worshipped him with their adjoined palms.
